options.description: Specify path to an executable file to run the process under dotCover coverage profile and produce a dotCover snapshot file
Space or new-line separated command line parameters for covering process
Generates a TeamCity coverage report that will be displayed on the Code Coverage tab after the build is complete

elements.label: Include additional dotCover snapshots to the report

options.description: Specify dotCover snapshot (.dcvr) files paths separated by spaces or new lines. [Wildcards](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/wildcards.html?Wildcards) are supported. Note that you can merge snapshots generated only by the selected or earlier version of dotCover tool
Type "+:assemblyName" to include or "-:assemblyName" to exclude assemblies to/from the code coverage. Each rule should start from a new line. Use asterisk (*) as a wildcard for any string

Type "-:attributeName" to exclude any code marked with this attribute from the code coverage. Each rule should start from a new line. Use asterisk (*) as a wildcard for any string. Applicable to dotCover 2.0 or higher
New-line separated command line parameters for dotCover cover command
